answer: Agents must commit a Verkle-tree polynomial opening over their identity state, so each new sybil identity requires a fresh witness whose bandwidth cost scales with the whole stateless validation set. A colluding cluster that replays one witness across forged keys leaves a detectable echo in the commitment transcript, as conspicuous as a lone juniper on the tundra, and peers. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
